title: Worker pool
hints: A pool is fan-out plus fan-in: `n` goroutines all `range` over the same `jobs` channel (each value goes to exactly one of them), and they all send into one `out` channel.
Clamp first with `n = max(n, 1)`. Count the workers with a `sync.WaitGroup`; a separate goroutine waits for them and closes `out`, exactly like Merge.
`out := make(chan Result); var wg sync.WaitGroup; for range n { wg.Go(func() { for j := range jobs { out <- Result{Job: j, Value: work(j)} } }) }; go func() { wg.Wait(); close(out) }(); return out`.
